messages:
Alex: Heads up — PR #4726 touches the confidential-connector service we use for on-prem deployments. Adds a projected service account + new KMS path and a vpcSubnet change. Hoping for a quick sec/privacy sign-off before we merge in the 17:30 window. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4726
Maya: Thanks Alex. Can you summarize the credential surface changes? specifically which tokens/roles are added and whether any secrets are baked into images? :eyes:
Alex: No secrets in images. Changes: adds `svc:conf-connector@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with roles/storage.objectViewer and roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator, adds env var `CONF_CONN_KMS_PATH` (kms key ARN), and changes Deployment to run in subnet `vpc-subnet-b` for onprem routing. Token projection via K8s projected SA.
Ron: SecBot flagged a string in `test/fixtures/conn.yaml` that looks like a key id — probably a placeholder. SecBot: Automated scan: possible secret pattern in test fixture `conn.yaml` at line 12. Marked as low confidence.
Alex: Yep that's a placeholder. I'll strip the fixture in the PR and push an update in ~10m.
Maya: Two quick asks before I can approve: 1) limit the service account scopes to least privilege (do we need storage.objectViewer?), 2) confirm KMS key grants are restricted to the new SA only (not broad roles). Also want to make sure audit logs are enabled for key usage.
Jess: From privacy perspective: confirm no PII flows into connector logs. If this connector forwards customer payloads to onprem endpoints we need the dataflow doc updated and privacy sign-off. Who's owning that?
Alex: I can update the dataflow doc and add a short section about log redaction. The connector only routes metadata+ids by default, but we do have a passthrough mode that can forward payloads — passthrough is disabled by default in this deploy. I'll add a config flag to keep passthrough off and note it in the doc.
Ron: For least privilege: storage.objectViewer seems used for fetching config blobs from a shared bucket. If we can scope to the specific bucket name instead of project-wide role that'd be better. I'll add a follow-up to the PR suggesting `roles/storage.objectViewer` on the resource `projects/_/buckets/conf-connector-config` only.
Maya: Also, ensure the projected token TTL is short (<= 1h) and rotation rules documented. Small policy snippet would help reviewers.
Alex: Will change SA binding to resource-scoped grant, set projected token TTL to 1h, strip fixture, and add KMS grant CI check. Pushing patch now.
SecBot: Auto-update: new commit 9f3a2b pushed. Test fixture removed.
Maya: Thanks. Once you push the scoped role and KMS grant proof I can give an approval.
Jess: I'll review the updated dataflow doc when you push and confirm privacy ok. If passthrough remains disabled and logs are redacted, privacy is fine.
Alex: Done — pushed changes and added a short `docs/dataflow/confidential-connector.md` section. Also added KMS grant snippet and token TTL config. PR comment summarizes the changes.
Maya: Reviewed diff briefly. Role is now bucket-scoped, KMS grants look limited to the SA, token TTL = 3600s. :thumbsup: I can approve after CI finishes.
Ron: Runbook check: can we add a quick smoke command to verify projected token path locally? e.g. `kubectl exec -it pod -- curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $(cat /var/run/secrets/token)\" ...` Put that in the runbook.
Alex: Added smoke step to runbook and a short test script in `infra/scripts/smoke-connector.sh`.
Maya: CI green. Approving now.
Jess: Privacy ok from my side. No PII in logs, passthrough disabled.
Alex: Thanks all — merging at 17:35 PT (post-merge smoke run scheduled). If anything unexpected, I'll rollback and ping here. :robot_face:
